name: DEMO | Fluke 87V DC voltage
notes: DEMONSTRATION ONLY. Fluke 87V normal 6000-count mode against Agilent 34401A reference in fixed 10 V range. Manufacturer DC voltage accuracy specifications, one year at 23 +/- 5 C. Illustrative comparison-method model: reference specification bound and UUT resolution, plus assumed source residual stability +/-20 uV and thermal EMF +/-2 uV. Rectangular distributions. Reference resolution/noise covered by reference accuracy specification; no separate noise row. Uncorrelated terms; results are not a calibration certificate. Sources and assumptions accompany this example.
